Q1: Butylbenzene presents known hazards for environmental, inhalation, and oral toxicity (Tier 1). It also shows an expanded perspective of potential hazards for endocrine disruption and dermal/eye effects (Tier 2). Data regarding carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards, and specific organ/systemic effects are currently deficient (Tier 4).
Q2: Butylbenzene is identified on the TEDX list, indicating it is considered a potential endocrine disruptor. There are no associated lists of low hazard for this chemical.
Q3: Butylbenzene is extensively studied, with over 7,400 scientific references and a well-defined molecular structure. While it lacks an EPA IRIS assessment, it has undergone a Provisional Peer-Reviewed Toxicity Value (PPRTV) assessment, and its 52 toxicity value records indicate significant toxicological study, though some specific hazard areas remain data deficient.
